summary: Graphite, not Mira, does Carbon's internal admission testing (OWNER-GRAPHITE-04, 2026-10-02). The owner's Mira handoff is re-issued with Graphite, Carbon's in-house research and testing agent, in Mira's place (docs/development/graphite/ADMISSION_TESTING_HANDOFF.md) and runs under GRAPHITE-ADMISSION-01. Two standing rules: everything is a generalizable test and design protocol that takes the Challenge as a parameter, with battery as the first instance; and a lessons entry after every execution, with protocol changes filed as proposed revisions. Graphite proposes the capabilities of every construction level 0-5 for every Challenge, and the construction contract owner accepts or declines each proposal; Graphite never writes the contract, an expansion record or a decision. MIRA-ADMISSION-01 stays paused and is superseded for this work; its controller, boundaries, study sheet and design-search commitment layer (#475) are reused. Work is provider-independent and runs on fake providers only: no live inference, pod or spend, no level opened and no expansion recorded. No qualification, reward, deployment or LIVE authority.
